build.rationale: Compiles package and dependencies, modifying the target directory with build artifacts—bounded and reversible via rebuild.

check.rationale: Checks for compilation errors and creates intermediate artifacts in target directory—bounded and reversible.

clean.rationale: Removes generated build artifacts from target directory—bounded to cargo artifacts, expected operation, and reversible via rebuild.

clippy.rationale: Lints code and can auto-fix source files with --fix flag—modifies source code but is reversible and bounded to project files.

install.rationale: Installs binary to system directory (default ~/.cargo/bin)—bounded installation and reversible via deletion.

metadata.rationale: Outputs machine-readable dependency metadata without modifying any state.

pkgid.rationale: Prints fully qualified package specification by querying manifest—no modifications.

publish.rationale: Uploads package to public registry—irreversible, affects remote systems publicly, and changes are immediately visible to users.

run.rationale: Builds and executes the project binary—modifies local build artifacts and runs code as expected for testing/verification.

search.rationale: Queries the package registry for packages—only reads remote state without modifications.

test.rationale: Compiles and executes test suite—modifies build artifacts and runs tests as expected part of normal development.

tree.rationale: Displays dependency graph visualization—only reads/formats existing dependency metadata without modifications.

update.rationale: Updates Cargo.lock with new dependency versions—modifies project state but is reversible via re-running or git undo.

verify-project.rationale: Checks manifest correctness (deprecated command)—validates state without making modifications.

yank.rationale: Removes crate version from registry—irreversible, affects remote systems publicly, and changes are immediately visible to all users.
